ai_summary: Genesys International Corporation Limited issued a clarification responding to stock exchange inquiries about significant share price movement, asserting it has no undisclosed material events. The company specifically addressed a news report detailing a potential ₹240 crore contract from Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation, clarifying it has not yet formally received the award and did not authorize the report. This situation highlights market speculation based on unconfirmed information, posing a risk to investors trading on unverified news.
